description: A component that renders only on the server or at build time. It can be async and access server resources, but cannot use state, effects or event handlers.
Directive that marks a module as the boundary where Client Components start. The module and its imports ship to the browser.
Directive that marks async functions as Server Functions callable from the client through a network request.
Values that can cross from Server to Client Components: primitives, plain objects, arrays, Dates, Maps, Sets, Promises, JSX and Server Functions.
Critical December 2025 RCE in the RSC packages, fixed together with follow-up DoS and source exposure CVEs in 19.0.4, 19.1.5 and 19.2.4.
